method: Built-in image generation, one independent image per published module. Compressed local JPEG assets; no external image dependency.
sharedPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE premium editorial photograph for a survival education module cover. Landscape composition, 1024 by 640 pixels, edge-to-edge photograph. Subject: {scene}. Visual family: realistic natural textures, deep forest green and charcoal shadows, restrained warm amber highlights, cinematic outdoor magazine photography. Make the module subject immediately recognizable; keep the main subject in the middle 65 percent of the frame so the image works in both wide cards and lesson headers. Actual photographic scene, not a diagram or interface. No text, labels, lettering, numbers, logos, watermarks, collage, frames, or fake UI. No gratuitous weapons, blood, injury, or unsafe demonstrations. No text even on screens, labels, or papers. Each cover must have its own composition and objects related specifically to this module.
